title: id-slang-synthetic-nlp Dataset Schema
description: Strict schema for the Indonesian Casual Language & Slang Synthetic Dataset.

konteks_percakapan.description: Natural synthetic Indonesian casual conversation or sentence.

ragam_slang.description: Slang word, phrase, internet expression, regional expression, or informal linguistic feature.

sentimen_emosi.description: Sentiment or emotional label associated with the conversational context.

lokasi_dominan.description: Dominant geographic, demographic, community, or linguistic context.
